note: EDIT ME — confirm against the monorepo README. packages/engine currently holds praxis and scram; canopy is a separate repository.

packages.name: praxis
packages.blurb: PRA eXecution and Insight System. The default solver — Rust, PDAG-based, with optional CUDA acceleration. Reads the OpenPRA MEF directly and exposes itself to the platform through NAPI-RS bindings.

packages.name: scram
packages.blurb: The original quantification engine, still maintained and still the reference the newer solvers are checked against.

packages.name: canopy
packages.blurb: Monte Carlo quantification of Boolean logic on hardware-accelerated platforms, developed in its own repository.

packages.name: shared-types
packages.blurb: Pure TypeScript definitions. The single source of truth for every domain type and DTO.

packages.name: mef-schema
packages.blurb: The OpenPRA MEF, generated as JSON Schema from shared-types.

packages.name: frontend-web-editor
packages.blurb: React and TypeScript workbooks — the interface analysts actually use.

packages.name: raptor
packages.blurb: RabbitMQ job broker that scales quantification across workers.

packages.name: pracciolini
packages.blurb: Format translation, including a SAPHIRE round trip through PRAXIS.
